newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Netcare up on talk Clinic deal soon.
newsitem.headline: Netcare up on talk Clinic deal soon.

text.p: Network Healthcare Holdings Ltd shares were firm in brisk trade on Thursday on rumour that the merger deal between itself and Clinic Holdings Ltd would be announced soon, dealers said.
"It is on the Clinic Holdings deal and other acquisitions. I would say the deal is imminent, within a week," one dealer said.

The share was the most actively traded share by volume and moves. It hit a day's high of 194 cents before settling 14 cents higher at 188 cents with 6.27 million shares valued at 11.7 million rand changing hands.
"There is no one big trade, just everyone involved in it. I must say there is good interest in it," one said.
Clinic Holdings said at the end of last month that talks with Netcare were advanced and could see the change of control of Clinics to Netcare.
